title: Murder Mystery Scavenger Hunt: Old Town San Diego
includes: All materials needed for the game
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Must be able to travel approximately 2 miles on foot.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
An outdoor daytime activity designed to be engaging and entertaining for adults!

Explore historic Old Town San Diego & collaborate with your team to solve logic-based clues to reveal the murderer. 

Not a gimmicky phone app guided tour, this is a hosted event. You’ll compete against other teams scattered throughout the area, each leading their own separate investigation. The team that reveals the murderer, needing the least help from headquarters, and is the fastest wins! 

Great fun for both locals and tourists.
